faq.title: FAQ's
faq.helpText: Send us an email and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

q1.question: How does renting a toy work?
q1.answer: Find a toy your child will love, pick rental dates, send a request, and meet the owner to pick it up. Return it clean and on time.

q2.question: Is it safe to rent toys from other families?
q2.answer: Owners share photos, condition, and hygiene notes. Every booking goes through the owner so you always know who you are renting from.

q3.question: How are toys cleaned between rentals?
q3.answer: Owners describe how each toy is cleaned in the listing. Every listing also sets a loss & damage compensation amount — what the renter would owe the owner for damage or excessive wear.

q4.question: What if my child loses a part of the toy?
q4.answer: Report it to the owner as soon as possible. The listing's loss & damage compensation amount is the most the owner can ask you for — agree the details directly with them.

q5.question: Can I cancel a rental?
q5.answer: You can cancel a pending rental request at any time. Once approved, cancellation depends on the owner’s policy.

q6.question: What do I need to list a toy?
q6.answer: Create an account, add at least one clear photo, choose a toy category, add a description and a daily price. You'll also add an optional age range and set a loss & damage compensation amount — what the renter would owe you if the toy is lost, seriously damaged or not returned.

about.heroLead: We believe every child deserves access to great toys — without the clutter or the price tag.
about.missionP1: DoRent started with a simple observation: children outgrow their toys quickly, yet new toys are expensive and often end up forgotten in storage. We built this platform to help families share the toys they already have — reducing waste, saving money, and giving every child access to a wider world of play.
about.missionP2: Our goal is to make toy sharing as easy and trustworthy as borrowing from a neighbor you already know. Every listing is reviewed by our team, and every owner shares the condition, hygiene notes, and safety details of their toy before it goes live.
about.step1Text: Browse toys by name, category, or age range. Use filters on the listings page to narrow down by price or toy type.
about.step2Text: Found something your child will love? Send a rental request to the owner, choose your dates, and wait for confirmation.
about.step3Text: Meet the owner, pick up the toy, and let the fun begin. Return it clean and on time — then discover the next one.
about.trust1Text: Every toy listing is manually reviewed before it appears on the platform. We check photos, descriptions, and toy details to ensure quality and accuracy.
about.trust2Text: Owners are required to provide the toy's condition, hygiene notes, and any relevant safety information. You always know what you're renting before you commit.
about.trust3Text: You rent directly from real families, not anonymous sellers. Communication happens through our platform so both parties are always informed and protected.
about.moderationIntro: When a family lists a toy, it enters a pending review state and is not publicly visible until approved. Our moderation team checks each submission for:
about.moderationItem4: Absence of prohibited or unsafe items
about.moderationOutro: Once approved, the owner receives an email confirmation and the listing goes live. Listings that do not meet our standards are rejected with a clear reason, and owners can resubmit after making corrections.
about.ctaText: Ready to find the perfect toy for your child?

faq.heroLead: Find answers to the most common questions about renting and listing toys.
faq.contactText: Still have a question? We're happy to help.

r1.question: How does renting a toy work?
r1.answer: Browse the catalogue, find a toy your child will love, and send a rental request to the owner. Choose your preferred dates and add a note if you like. The owner will accept or decline your request. Once accepted, coordinate pickup directly with the owner. Return the toy clean and on time.

r2.question: How do I search for a toy?
r2.answer: Use the search bar on the homepage to find toys by name. On the Browse Toys page you can also filter by category, price range, and age suitability. Browse curated sections like "Popular Toys" and "Most Recent" on the home page.

r4.question: How does pickup and return work?
r4.answer: Pickup and return are arranged directly between the renter and the owner — typically at a convenient location you both agree on. All communication happens through the platform so everything stays on record.

l1.question: How do I list my toy?
l1.answer: Sign in, go to "List a Toy" in the menu, and fill in the toy details: name, description, category, age range, condition, hygiene notes, photos, and daily price. Submit and our team will review it. You'll receive an email once approved.

l2.question: How long does approval take?
l2.answer: Most listings are reviewed within 24 hours. You can track the status of your listings under "My Toys." Once approved, your toy becomes visible to all families on the platform.

l3.question: Can I set my own price?
l3.answer: Yes. You choose the daily rental price. We recommend pricing that reflects the toy's value and condition.

l4.question: What toys can I list?
l4.answer: Any age-appropriate, safe, and clean toy in reasonable condition. Prohibited items include broken or damaged toys, toys with choking hazards for the listed age group, toys with missing safety certifications, or anything unsuitable for children.

s1.question: How do I know a toy is clean?
s1.answer: Owners must provide hygiene notes when listing — describing how the toy is cleaned between rentals. All listings go through a manual review, and listings without adequate hygiene information are rejected.

s2.question: What if I receive a damaged or incorrect toy?
s2.answer: Please contact us immediately via email if a toy does not match its listing or arrives damaged. We take every report seriously and investigate promptly.

s3.question: Are listings checked for safety?
s3.answer: Yes. Our moderation team reviews every new listing for safety, accuracy, and quality before it goes live. We check photos, descriptions, age suitability, and the owner's stated condition and hygiene notes.

p1.question: How do payments work?
p1.answer: At this stage of the platform, payments are handled directly between the renting family and the listing owner. The platform does not process any financial transactions. Always agree on the amount and method before pickup.

a1.question: How do I create an account?
a1.answer: Click "Sign Up" in the header, provide your name, email address, and a secure password. You'll be logged in immediately. An email address is required for listing approvals and booking notifications.

a2.question: I forgot my password. What do I do?
a2.answer: Password reset is coming soon. In the meantime, please contact us via email and we will assist you manually.

a3.question: How do I contact support?
a3.answer: Send us an email at support@dorent.am and we will get back to you as soon as possible. We aim to respond within 1 business day.

We do not own, inspect, store, deliver or insure the toys.

You can register with an email address and password, or with Sign in with Google.
You are responsible for everything done through your account.

Owners must describe the toy honestly: its condition, completeness, age range and any defects. Photos must show the actual toy.
Toys must be clean and sanitised before every rental.
Owners set the price and a loss & damage compensation amount. Owners decide how the toy is handed over: pickup from the home point and/or delivery.
Every listing is reviewed by our moderators before it appears publicly. We may refuse, hide or remove any listing that does not meet these Terms.

blocks.p: You may not list toys that are:

list: broken or unsafe, or a choking hazard for the stated age;
recalled by the manufacturer or the authorities;
counterfeit, or infringe someone else's rights;
not meant for children, or inappropriate for them;

blocks.p: You may not list items that are not toys, such as weapons or dangerous goods.

list: A rental agreement is formed directly between the Owner and the Renter when the Owner approves a booking request.

items: return it complete, in the same condition and on the agreed date.

DoRent does **not** process payments. Rental fees, delivery costs and any loss & damage compensation are agreed and paid **directly between the Owner and the Renter**, outside the Platform.
The loss & damage compensation amount shown on a listing is the amount the Renter agrees to pay the Owner if the toy is lost or damaged. DoRent never collects, holds or refunds it.
Agree on payment terms clearly before you confirm a rental.

blocks.p: Reviews must be honest and about a real rental.

list: Disputes about a rental (the condition of a toy, late returns, payments) must be resolved between the Owner and the Renter.

intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data DoRent ("DoRent", "we", "us") collects when you use dorent.am (the "Platform"), why we collect it, who can see it, and what rights you have. For any privacy question, write to **support@dorent.am**.
DoRent is a platform where families in Armenia rent toys from each other. The Platform is intended for adults (18+). We do not knowingly collect personal data about children.

list: Your email address, first name and last name.
Your phone number. We ask for it at registration, or the first time you publish a listing or send a booking request.
A securely hashed version of your password. We never store your password in plain text. If you only sign in with Google, you have no password with us.
Your preferred language (English, Armenian or Russian).

blocks.p: If you choose "Continue with Google", Google sends us:

list: your Google account identifier;
your email address and whether Google has verified it;
your name;
the address of your profile picture;
for Google Workspace accounts, your organisation's domain.

blocks.p: We use this only to create your account or sign you in. We do not receive your Google password, and we do not access your contacts, files, calendar or any other Google data.
To list toys, you set a home point on a map: the place renters pick toys up from.

list: We store the exact point you choose.
Other users never see it. They see only your district and an approximate area of about 100 metres. You share the exact address with a renter yourself, in the chat, after a booking.
We also use your home point to show you how far toys are from you.
If you use "my current location" while browsing, that position is used only in your browser to calculate distances. It is not sent to us.

blocks.p: The content you publish: the toy's name, description, photos, category, age range, condition, price, loss & damage compensation amount, and delivery options.

list: Your booking requests and their status, and the optional note you write to the owner.
Chat messages and the photos you send in a chat.

items: The **written comment** of a review is public.
The **individual scores** are shown to others only as averages, never with your name attached.

list: Reports you file about listings, users or messages.
Your favourites and in-app notifications.
When you use the Platform, our servers and our network provider process your IP address and basic request information (browser type, pages requested).
We use it to deliver the service, limit abuse (for example, too many sign-in attempts), keep the Platform secure and fix errors. Server logs are kept only for a short time.
We do not use advertising or tracking cookies and we do not build advertising profiles.

blocks.p: We store your sign-in token and your language choice in your browser's local storage, so you stay signed in and see the Platform in your language. This is not shared with anyone. Signing out removes the sign-in token.
We use your data only to:

list: create your account and sign you in, including confirming your email address;
show your listings and your public profile (name, district, reviews) to other users;
let owners and renters make and manage bookings and talk to each other;
show distances and approximate locations;
moderate listings and keep the Platform safe: review reports, prevent fraud, suspend accounts that break our Terms;
answer your questions;
keep the Platform working and secure.

blocks.p: We process your data because it is necessary to provide the service you asked for, to keep the Platform safe (our legitimate interest), or because the law requires it.

items: your first name and last name;
list.note: They never see your email address, phone number, exact home point or password.

list: **Photos in chats** are delivered by a direct link. Anyone who has that link can open the photo, so only share photos you are comfortable with.
**DoRent moderators and administrators** can see account data, including your phone number, listings and reports. They need this to run and protect the Platform.

list.text: **Service providers** who process data for us only to provide their service:
items: **Google** (Sign in with Google, only if you use it);
**OpenStreetMap** (map tiles; your browser loads them directly from their servers, which see your IP address).
list.note: Some of these providers process data outside Armenia.

list: **Authorities**, when the law requires us to disclose data.

blocks.p: We do not sell or rent your personal data, and we do not share it for marketing.
We send only service emails, such as confirming your email address. We do not send marketing emails. If we ever do, you will be able to opt out.

list: We keep your account data while your account exists.

If you ask us to delete your account, we delete or anonymise your personal data within 30 days. Some records may be kept longer where the law requires it, or where they are needed to resolve a dispute or protect another user.
Backup copies are kept for 7 days and then overwritten.
An unconfirmed registration that is never completed may be removed.

blocks.p: You can ask us to:

list: give you a copy of your data;
correct it;
delete your account and data;
stop or limit some processing.

blocks.p: You can change your name and phone number yourself in your profile. For anything else, write to **support@dorent.am** from the email address of your account. We will answer within 30 days.
We protect your data with:

list: encrypted connections (HTTPS);
hashed passwords;
access limited to the people who need it;
regular backups.

blocks.p: No system is perfectly secure. If we learn of a breach that affects you, we will tell you.
We may update this policy as the Platform changes. We will publish the new version on this page with a new date. For important changes, we will also tell registered users by email or on the Platform.
